ranking_metric: deps.dev directDependentCount summed over all releases
selection: jcodec 0.2.5 has the highest summed deps.dev direct dependents (76; single-release max 44) among leads whose own Java code parses and decodes MPEG Layer III frames from a documented local file/channel API. javacv (315) and org.bytedeco:ffmpeg (215) rank higher but are JNI wrappers over native FFmpeg with no Java parser source.
family_note: Same JCodec MPEGAudioDemuxer family as the jcodec entry in the active mp3_id3v2/java cell; not an independent parser family.
uncertainty: Pilot cell: only the highest-adoption pure-Java Layer III path was built and control-verified; no padding. Maven Central Solr search ranks by relevance, the phrase queries 'mp3 decoder' and 'mpeg audio' returned 0 hits, so leads were looked up directly on deps.dev and logged in leads.json. deps.dev public coverage is incomplete and jcodec's count covers the whole codec library, not MP3 use alone. Two untagged CBR controls do not establish VBR, Xing/Info, free-format, Layer I/II, MPEG-2.5 or intensity-stereo support; jcodec's Mp3Decoder throws on intensity stereo by design. Java SE 25 exports no MP3 API, so the standard count is zero by inventory.
